sources.label: People crying about gen AI are pathetic

This guy wanted to create a game but has no skills in digital art and sound design so he used gen ai to create icons and sfx. And you crying about a 5 euro game. Go pester activision when they use gen ai instead of hiring artists even though they have billions of dollars. One man dev teams can and should use AI to help with development. We need more indie games, not less
Emrecds View Profile View Posts [developer] Aug 27 @ 2:26pm Report this post Thank you so much for your valuable feedback. People sometimes lump independent two-person studios and billion-dollar companies into the same category, and that can be frustrating. reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 SAT Productions，发行商同名）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 33），首页有 2 个与 AI 直接相关的主题，已逐帖读取原文：一帖是玩家为 AI 制作辩护并对比大厂，跟帖里有开发者账号致谢；另一帖是玩家表示因使用 AI 而不购买。两帖属玩家与开发者的立场表达，按规则只登记不判定，不改变任何领域结论。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 2 篇原始来源（AI Transparency Index 复刻披露的分析页；Open Credits 把披露拆成界面与音频两类，其分类来自模型判读）。两者都不是独立核实。领域判定全部来自商店披露原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
disclosureQuote: Only the game's music and some GUI icons were created with the assistance of AI.
disclosureQuoteNote: Steam 商店 AI 生成内容披露栏完整原文，2026-11-03 核查；可能随商店页更新。

english.summary: A multiplayer voice-mimicry party game released on Aug 21, 2026. The developer states that only the game's music and some GUI icons were created with the assistance of AI.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer SAT Productions, self-published) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 33), where two topics directly concern AI use; both threads were opened and read in full. One thread defends the use of AI by a small studio against larger companies and includes a reply from the developer account thanking players, the other states a player will not buy the game because of AI use. Both are opinions and second-hand statements, so they are logged without changing any area finding. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 2 raw source(s) were read: an AI Transparency Index page reproducing the disclosure and an Open Credits page that splits it into interface and audio, a model classification of the same text. Neither is independent verification. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text itself and rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit.
